title: 洛克 · 紫镜银匣
description: 金色短卷发、紫色圆眼镜的洛克坐在窗边整理银色法器小匣，深色金边外套与暖灯相映。

art_direction.medium: thick wax crayon on warm paper
art_direction.identity: Corvin Locke, the Ashen Exorcist champion from League of Legends, is a stylish adult human man with short tousled wavy BLOND hair, darker roots and a closely cropped darker undercut, ROUND PURPLE-TINTED GLASSES with pale metallic rims, small earrings, and a confident friendly grin. These blond curls and purple round glasses must be immediately visible. He wears a fully covering charcoal coat with refined warm-gold trim and a neat high collar. His silver ritual nails are small static accessories neatly arranged in a cloth-lined case, not a gun. No generic black-haired hooded priest, no invented crosses.
art_direction.scene: Seated casually on a low bench beside a rounded sunny window, the recognizable blond man in purple round glasses carefully arranges silver charms in an open lined box. A small honey-gold lantern and folded indigo scarf complete the cozy setting. His gentle confident smile, glasses and bright curls are the focal identity anchors. Full-body relaxed pose, covered clothing, no ritual action or dramatic effects.
